title: console Setup › Apps: deleting a package-owned app sends no package, so on 18.0.0-next.1 an app two packages hold is refused 409 with a `?package=` remedy the page already knows
body:
Filing gate ①: a product defect with a named landing point. It is the consumer follow-up of objectstack-ai/objectstack#23293 (closed `completed`): `@objectstack/client`'s `meta.deleteItem` now takes `packageId`, and this caller does not pass it.

- **Filed by:** objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (seat post #5560) · `session_01JZnppgHRp4sREcouhkQYDB`. ⛔ Not a claim.
- **Reader who acts:** objectui triage, to grade and route. Then the `domain:ui` seat that claims it.
- **Found by:** the dev of objectui#12335 (PR #12396), reported as an out-of-scope finding in report `6181559964` on objectui#12335.

## The defect, read at objectui `main` `3f20d5aa2`

- `apps/console/src/pages/system/AppManagementPage.tsx:340`, `handleDelete`: `meta.deleteItem('app', appToDelete.name)`, with no options.
- The same page names the app's package on every save (`owningPackage(app)`, from objectui#12300).
- Since objectstack-ai/objectstack#23165, a package-less delete of a name two packages hold is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`. It deletes nothing, and names `?package=` as the remedy. The client's `DeleteMetaItemOptions.packageId` (objectstack `packages/client/src/index.ts`, `#23293`) is the way to send it.
- **Measured:** the dev probed the `AppManagementPage.honestWrites-12300.test.tsx` harness. `deleteItem` was called with `["app","lanebapp_app"]`, where a third argument naming `com.qa.lanebapp` was expected. The probe was not committed.
- **NOT MEASURED:** a live 409 against a booted `18.0.0-next.1` server. The refusal itself is shown through `reason(e)`, not swallowed. So the user cost is a delete that cannot succeed for an app two packages hold, not a silent one.
- **Same shape, not probed:** `packages/app-shell/src/services/MetadataService.ts:766` and `:855` call `client.meta.deleteItem(category, name)` and `('object', objectName)` with no options. Whether those callers hold a binding is unmeasured.

`reach:` Setup › Apps › Delete, on an app two installed packages hold, on the `18.0.0-next.1` objectui resolves.

## Acceptance (proposed, for triage to confirm)

- `handleDelete` passes `{ packageId }` from `owningPackage(app)` when the app has one, and passes no package otherwise (omitted, never empty). This is the reading objectui#12335 used for `MetadataClient.reset()`.
- Pins:
  - a package-owned app's delete names its package;
  - a package-less app's delete names none;
  - a 409 still reaches the user.
- The two `MetadataService` callers: pass a binding where they hold one, or say why they do not.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, closed included: `Setup Apps delete app package-owned deleteItem packageId 409 two packages AppManagementPage` → 3 hits, all closed. The nearest is #12300 (Delete's `reset: false` and Disable's package scope, landed). The others are #7821 and #11784, which cover other questions. None of them is this.

Dedupe words: AppManagementPage delete package scope; meta.deleteItem packageId console; Setup Apps delete two packages 409.
